fields.Name: Integration Test: FLS Reader
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for Field-Level Security coverage. Grants READ ONLY on 'MJ: Employees' and nothing else, so a user whose only role is this one gets the snapshot default Allow/No Access/No Access on every restrictable Employee field. The fls-enforcement bundle tightens specific rows on this role at runtime (Deny on Email, row deleted for BCMID) and restores them in teardown. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-fls-* test accounts.

fields.Name: Integration Test: FLS Writer
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for Field-Level Security coverage. Grants read+create+update+delete on 'MJ: Employees', so the snapshot writes Allow/Allow/Allow on every restrictable field — the 'unrestricted user' contrast leg of the fls-enforcement bundle, and the Allow contributor for the multi-role aggregation checks (Deny-beats-Allow, No-Access neutrality, cross-role read clamp). Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-fls-* test accounts.

fields.Name: Integration Test: FLS Denier
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for Field-Level Security coverage. Grants READ ONLY on 'MJ: Employees'; the fls-enforcement bundle rewrites specific permission rows on this role at runtime (Deny on Title for Deny-beats-Allow and the cross-role read-required clamp; Allow/Deny/Deny on Phone for update-denial and create suppression) and restores them in teardown. Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-fls-multi test account.

fields.Name: Integration Test: FLS Neutral
fields.Description: Integration-test-only role for Field-Level Security coverage. Grants READ ONLY on 'MJ: Employees'; the fls-enforcement bundle sets this role's rows to No Access at runtime to prove No Access is neutral in the cross-role aggregation (a user also holding an Allow role keeps access). Safe to delete; assign only to the seeded it-fls-multi test account.
